notes: origin_status to confirm (2026-11-02): E-Flora BC lists Achillea millefolium sensu stricto as Exotic (SNA) and the native coastal yarrow under Achillea borealis var. borealis (Yellow, S5); USDA gives both native and introduced for Canada. The entity keeps native_bc_west_of_cascades because the native coastal taxon is what a BC planting means by 'yarrow'; the claims record each source's wording (ecological_value:eflora01 cites the A. borealis page).
